rules.name: canary-failed
rules.title: Package snapshot failed on its canary
rules.summary: A new package snapshot failed its canary's update or tests and was not promoted. Sites stay on the current lock.

rules.name: snapshot-stale
rules.title: Package snapshot is stale
rules.summary: No snapshot has been promoted for this runtime for two days, so sites receive no package updates.

rules.name: update-wave-halted
rules.title: Site update wave halted
rules.summary: A site failed to upgrade to the current snapshot, so the other sites of its runtime skip that snapshot until a new one is promoted.

rules.name: mirror-failed
rules.title: Site repository cannot be mirrored
rules.summary: The webhost container could not fetch a site's repository for half an hour. The site keeps serving its current release.
